note: Provenance is checked against this registry, and independence needs an onboarding record: a reviewer cannot become independent by editing a boolean, and cannot onboard themselves.

agent://session-author.note: wrote these cases and reviews them; a verified author attestation proves the payload was not altered, not that anyone independent looked at it

onboarding.declaration: wrote the cases; an author review is not independent

onboarding_policy.requires_authorization: onboarding.authorized_by must name the human who approved the role
onboarding_policy.no_self_onboarding: a reviewer may not authorize their own independence
onboarding_policy.independence_declared: onboarding.independent must be true for benchmark eligibility
onboarding_policy.not_the_author: the onboarding record must state that the reviewer did not author the cases
